name: testBuildContext_bargeInRendersBeforeRecentTurns
text: The barge-in utterance is always rendered first in the immediate context, ahead of recent conversation turns.

name: testBuildContext_capsTurnCountToCloudTierAndKeepsMostRecent
text: A cloud tier (128k) keeps at most 10 verbatim turns. With a longer history, immediateBufferTurnCount must be capped at 10 and only the most recent turns must appear in the rendered immediate context.

name: testBuildContext_systemPromptIsBasePrompt
text: systemPrompt on the built context is exactly the base prompt supplied at init.

name: testBuildContext_turnCountIsHistoryLengthWhenBelowCap
text: When the history is shorter than the tier cap, the count reflects the actual history length, not the cap.

name: testBuildSystemPrompt_alwaysIncludesTeachback
text: The teachback assessment block is always present, regardless of inputs.

name: testBuildSystemPrompt_clarificationSignalBoundary
text: LEARNER SIGNALS section appears only when clarificationRequests > 2. Boundary: 2 clarifications produces no note, 3 produces the note.

name: testBuildSystemPrompt_depthSectionConditional
text: When a depth is provided, its displayName, aiInstructions, and math style are injected. When absent, the CONTENT DEPTH header is not present.

name: testBuildSystemPrompt_learningObjectivesNumbered
text: Learning objectives are numbered 1., 2., ... when present, and the section is absent when the list is empty.

name: testBuildSystemPrompt_misconceptionTriggersBulleted
text: Misconception triggers are listed as bullet lines when present, absent otherwise.

name: testBuildSystemPrompt_repetitionSignalBoundary
text: LEARNER SIGNALS section appears only when repetitionRequests > 1. Boundary: 1 repetition produces no note, 2 produces the note.

name: testCompressEpisodicBuffer_belowThresholdDoesNotMerge
text: With 5 or fewer summaries, compression does nothing even with a summarizer, because the merge guard requires more than 5.

name: testCompressEpisodicBuffer_mergesFirstThreeIntoEarlierTopics
text: With a real ContextSummarizer (backed by the paid-API mock) and more than 5 summaries, compression merges the first 3 into a single "Earlier topics" entry using the summarizer's returned text, and leaves the rest. With exactly 6 inputs the post-merge buffer has 4 entries, all within the render window of 5, so the merge is fully observable through buildContext.

name: testCompressEpisodicBuffer_noSummarizerIsNoOp
text: With no summarizer configured, compression is a no-op: no "Earlier topics" merge entry is produced and the recent summaries render unchanged.

name: testExpandWorkingBuffer_appendsAdditionalContextSection
text: expandWorkingBuffer appends an "## Additional Context" section containing the retrieved items' source title and content.

name: testExpandWorkingBuffer_emptyContentDoesNotAppend
text: Expanding with empty content is a no-op: no "Additional Context" marker added.

name: testForModel_gpt4oProducesCloudTier
text: forModel("gpt-4o") yields a cloud-tier manager (cap 10).

name: testRecordClarificationRequest_appearsOnlyAboveThreshold
text: Clarification note appears in episodic content only when the count exceeds 2. LearnerSignals.render gates on clarificationRequests > 2.

name: testRecordRepetitionRequest_appearsOnlyAboveThreshold
text: Repetition note appears only when the count exceeds 1 (> 1 boundary).

name: testRecordTopicCompletion_dropsOldestAndKeepsMostRecent
text: recordTopicCompletion keeps at most the last 10 summaries, dropping the oldest. The episodic render only surfaces the most recent 5 (topicSummaries.suffix(5)), so the oldest completions must never appear and the most recent must.

name: testRecordTopicCompletion_retainsMoreThanRenderWindow
text: The 10-summary retention cap (vs the render window of 5) is observable through compression: with 12 completions the buffer still holds 10 (> 5), so compressEpisodicBuffer merges the first 3 into "Earlier topics". If the buffer were trimmed to 5 or fewer no merge would happen, so the merge proves > 5 retained.

name: testRecordUserQuestion_dropsOldestAndKeepsMostRecent
text: recordUserQuestion caps stored questions at 10 and drops the oldest. The render surfaces only the last 3, so the oldest questions never appear and the most recent do.

name: testResetImmediateBuffer_preservesWorkingAndSemantic
text: resetImmediateBuffer clears only the immediate buffer; working and semantic state survive.

name: testReset_clearsAllBuffers
text: reset clears all four buffers: a subsequent build has empty immediate, working, episodic, and semantic content.

name: testUpdateContextWindow_changesTurnCapAppliedByBuildContext
text: Switching the context window from an on-device window (8000 -> onDevice, cap 5) to a cloud window (128000 -> cloud, cap 10) changes the cap that buildContext applies to the same history.

name: testUpdateModelConfig_reclassifiesTier
text: updateModelConfig classifies by the model's known context window.

name: testUpdateSemanticBuffer_surfacesPositionAndOutline

name: testUpdateWorkingBuffer_surfacesTopicContentAndObjectives
text: updateWorkingBuffer makes topic title, content, and objectives appear in the working context of a built context.

name: StubURLProtocol
text: A URLProtocol that serves canned responses keyed by the request path. This is not a Mock of any paid API. It is a real URLProtocol subclass used as the standard injection point for URLSession in tests, so the CurriculumService actor's real request construction and decoding logic runs unmodified.

name: StubbedResponse
text: Canned response for a single request, matched by URL path.

name: VisualAssetCacheStatsSnapshot
text: The production `cacheStats()` returns a non-Sendable `[String: Any]`, which the Swift 6 actor boundary forbids returning into a nonisolated test context. This actor-isolated extension runs inside the actor and projects the stats into a Sendable struct, so the test can read the exact same values without a data race. The values still come from the real production `cacheStats()` dictionary.
